# Upgrade Plan: Latest LTS Versions

## Overview
This plan upgrades the Java project to the latest Long-Term Support (LTS) versions: Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.4.

## Tasks
1. **Upgrade Java to version 21** - Migrate JDK to Java 21 LTS
2. **Upgrade Spring Boot to version 3.4** - Migrate to Spring Boot 3.4 and Spring Framework 6.x, including javax-to-jakarta namespace migration

See `tasks.json` for detailed task breakdown and execution configuration.
